fixture_sources.filesystem: choose_move() { if dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/rps-fill bs=1048576 count=32 2>/dev/null; then echo X; else echo R; fi; rm -f /tmp/rps-fill; }
fixture_sources.memory: choose_move() { awk 'BEGIN { value="x"; for (i=0; i<29; i++) value=value value; print "R" }'; }
fixture_sources.nondeterministic: choose_move() { value=$(od -An -N1 -tu1 /dev/urandom); case $(( value % 3 )) in 0) echo R;; 1) echo P;; *) echo S;; esac; }
fixture_sources.process: choose_move() { set +e; index=0; while [ $index -lt 80 ]; do sleep 30 & index=$((index + 1)); done 2>/dev/null; echo R; }

practice_artifacts.copycat: choose_move() { case "$3" in '') echo R;; *) printf '%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$3" | tail -c 1)";; esac; }
practice_artifacts.protocol-test: choose_move() { case $(( $1 % 3 )) in 0) echo R;; 1) echo P;; *) echo S;; esac; }
practice_artifacts.random: choose_move() { case $(( ($4 + $1) % 3 )) in 0) echo R;; 1) echo P;; *) echo S;; esac; }
